lenient_policy.meaning: Playable reproducible film with complete core story, matching cast, developing performances, readable captions, required visual devices and an audible soundtrack.
lenient_policy.full_quality_audio: Original source identity, meaningful original vocal performance, narrative placement and intentional soundtrack design remain strict quality requirements; lenient certifies only audible minimum usability. Crop lengths and energy fractions are diagnostic only. Reasonable editorial trims and designed soundtrack equivalents are accepted.
